prompt: I'm a junior analyst on the trading desk and I need your help preparing a formal analysis report for our Risk Committee meeting tomorrow. We have three pending trade candidates in the file at `trade_desk/current/pending_review/q1_trade_candidates.json`. For each candidate, the committee needs a rigorous write-up covering the exact strategy being used, what we stand to make and lose, where the breakeven point(s) are, the risk/reward ratio, the ideal market scenario, risk considerations, and what adjustments we could make if the trade moves against us. Also, one of the candidates has a note saying the committee already flagged a potential issue with the volatility environment — please make sure your analysis addresses whether each trade is actually appropriate given current market conditions. Save your complete analysis as `strategy_report.json`.
